# manif

This directory vendors the public headers from
[`artivis/manif`](https://github.com/artivis/manif), release `0.0.5`
(commit `dbd8181` from the GitHub release archive).

Only the header-only library and its MIT license are kept so Point-LIO builds
without fetching dependencies from the network. The upstream-bundled
`tl::optional` 1.0.0 header is included as well; its header declares the
CC0-1.0 public-domain dedication.
